article.title: Ainda não
article.part: Interrogación y negación — Interrogação e negação
article.chapter: Negación, polaridad y foco negativo — Negação, polaridade e foco negativo

claims.summary: Michaelis defines ainda as extending up to the present moment and documents the exact example ainda não almocei; the claim is limited to the non-realization of the situation by the reference time.

Gritti’s doctoral thesis studies ainda in Brazilian Portuguese; its repository abstract says ainda não does not determine tense/aspect and analyzes continuation and contextual expectations, so the phrase does not guarantee later realization.

locator.description: Verbete “ainda”, líneas 42–47; definición 1 en línea 45 y ejemplo literal “ainda não almocei”.

links.notes: El contenido usa el ejemplo exacto y limita el valor temporal al momento de referencia.
